domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 通过弹性或隔振支承将轨道板与基础相隔离的轨道结构。
usage_overview: 通过板下弹性支承实现隔振，用于车辆—轨道及其与下部结构耦合系统的减振分析和现场验证。研究可考察轨道板位移等响应；离散支承或点弹簧是其中的支承布置或建模方式。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Results show that the stochastic simulation of the vehicle–floating slab track system using PDEM is efficient and reliable compared with the Monte Carlo method.

Finally, stochastic analyses of the dynamic response and the vibration isolation performance of the floating slab track are carried out using the coupled vehicle–floating slab track system dynamics model.

For example, Kuo et al. [6] built the coupled equilibrium equations between the suspended wheels and floating-slab track (FST) system, where the equations are solved by the four-order Runge-Kutta method to obtain the system vibrations such as deflection, velocity and contact forces.

Emphasized on a special type of FST used in a subway, Alabbasi [12] made a research on its dynamic behavior with the development of a fast-running model verified by a 3D finite element model, especially, the effect of varying the thickness of the groove on the dynamic behavior of infinite tracks is investigated.
